tweets.text:
At the Queens field office, an alien thought they could slip through the cracks during an Adjustment of Status interview. 

But USCIS vetting revealed the truth—this individual was wanted for homicide/murder in Guyana since July 2015. @ICEgov and @USMarshalsHQ were contacted for apprehension. The fugitive was swiftly taken into custody and is now headed for removal proceedings.

USCIS is not just about granting benefits—it’s about protecting America, upholding the law, and ensuring justice is served. Criminal aliens don’t think you can evade us. We’re protecting Americans, one case at a time.
